decisions.reason: As a finish-led extension very close to the firm's existing drainage range, it fits strongly with its accumulated design and production know-how, so management would likely keep it unless demand for the black aesthetic proves too narrow.

A shower channel for seamless coverings is tightly aligned with the firm's core drainage competence and barrier-free bathroom focus, and the dedicated product-page launch suggests enough commitment and learning potential to retain it.

Although more complex because it adds pump-assisted functionality, it still builds on the firm's drainage knowledge and R&D base, so management would usually keep it for further learning unless installation or reliability feedback is disappointing.

This tileable floor drain sits very close to the established offer and customer base, allowing the firm to exploit existing technical knowledge, support capabilities, and market channels, which makes withdrawal unlikely.

A stainless steel design grate is an incremental, design-oriented addition that the firm can readily manufacture, market, and refine using its existing absorptive capacity, so it is likely to stay in the portfolio.
